Name: Zephaniah
Summary: Zephaniah, descended from King Hezekiah through Amariah, Gedaliah, and Cushi, prophesied in Judah during the reign of King Josiah. He warned of the day of the LORD against Judah's idolatry and the surrounding nations, then promised a restored, humble remnant whom God would gather and rejoice over with singing.
KeyStory: Zephaniah warned that the day of the LORD was near for Judah and the nations, then promised that God would gather a meek remnant and rejoice over them with singing.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Cushi, Father of Zephaniah; Gedaliah, Son of Amariah; Amariah, Son of Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Judgment and joy meet in Zephaniah: God confronts sin seriously, yet sings over the remnant He restores. Seek meekness now, before the day comes.
